name: Binding the Dreadnaught
label: Quest
description: Binding the Dreadnaught: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, adventurer? No, of course you haven't. You're still a kid - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.
You're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.
I need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you want? Directions? I can provide those...

clips.title: Completion
paras: This will do, for now. If you get more, you know where to find me.
